items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: You made a nice record with J.C. Higginbotham

ctx.x: Q What is that? What is a compound triplet? A triplet with 3 quarter notes, why they call it a compound I don't know. That was the particular name at that time.

Q You made a nice record with J.C. Higginbotham-- do you remember much about that at all? Yeah well see, I procured... I got them a lot of musicians that were idle and could use a gig. Like Coleman Hawkins wasn't doin' nothin'. And I suggested him, I said "I think I could get Coleman Hawkins" 'cause he and I good friends and as soon as I asked Hawk, he said "yeah, man-- for a session, yeah." But like I said it wound up at a later date, it was his session and not mine. But he had the stronger name, naturally. But…

that they didn't want, and all of a sudden... they don't consult me... I had to fight for the leadership fee, through I think it was Fox -- what's that company that gets your money back for you -- Fox. Some kind of Fox, I think it's Fox. Well, they help you get your royalties, you know, back. And it was finally switched around that I could, you know. They didn't even offer me that. They could say, 'well we would like to use this guy's name, put it here cause it sells more records, but you still get your fee' you…
